notes: Jewellery VAT 25% (PwC standard rate); investment gold is VAT-exempt under the EU special scheme (European Commission). sources.name: European Commission - VAT Special Schemes (Taxation and Customs)
sources.what: Type I investment-gold scheme is obligatory for EU countries: supply, intra-EU acquisition and importation of investment gold are normally exempt from VAT - gold vatBullionPct 0.
